title: Hassan II Mosque
summary: The Hassan II Mosque in Casablanca has a minaret 210 m high, among the tallest in the world. Construction began in 1986 and was meant to end for King Hassan II's 60th birthday in 1989, but it ran on to 1993. Its prayer hall holds about 25,000 people.

uncertainty.note: DLIFLC: construction began in 1986 and was delayed until 1993; Al Jazeera: inaugurated in 1993.

where.historical_name: Hassan II Mosque, Casablanca, Kingdom of Morocco

importance.justification: The Defense Language Institute guide lists it as one of the largest mosques in the world, with a minaret 210 m high.
